calls.video_title: Urgent: Buy Before October 28 (Investors Will FLOOD Into These Stocks)
calls.thesis: Guest Chris Marotch: Pfizer as a high-yield alternative to 5.2% Treasuries ahead of the late-Oct Fed meeting — revenue/earnings normalised post-Covid, large pipeline/acquisitions give many 'shots on goal', slow-and-steady growth story; up ~17% in last 3 months.
calls.base_case: Slow and steady total return: ~14% price gain YTD plus ~6% dividend (~20% total).
calls.bull_case: Pipeline drugs get approved through trials, including autoimmune/oncology candidates where it is a 'forgotten name' vs GLP-1 leaders.
calls.bear_case: Getting back to Covid-era highs requires pipeline successes actually crossing the finish line.
